Caus. बृंहयति, ˚ते (also written वृ˚), to make big or fat or strong, increase, expand, further, promote, MBh.; Kathās.; Pur.; Suśr.;

बृंहण mfn. (fr. Caus.) making big or fat or strong, nourishing, Suśr.
बृंहण m. a kind of sweetmeat, W.
बृंहण n. the act of making big &c., ib.
a means for making strong or firm, RPrāt.
बृंहण—त्व n. the quality of making fat or strong, Suśr.
the quality of making solid or firm, Hariv.
बृंहणीय mfn. to be fattened or nourished, Pāṇ. viii, 4, 2, Sch.
बृंहयितव्य mfn. to be nourished or strengthened, Suśr.
